rules.structure: Each question has core and extra, each with separate nodes and edges lists.
rules.nodes: Nodes are identified by id; name is the graph name for human reference. When the graph has no name, use the ID and explicitly mark name_source=id_fallback_no_graph_name.
rules.edges: Edges are identified by (type, start_id, end_id) in stored direction. Endpoints resolve against the union of core.nodes and extra.nodes. Parallel records sharing a triple are grouped; measurement and signal-property claims still require underlying records.
rules.core: All listed core nodes and edges are required. Retrieve complete relevant nodes, edges and their annotations; a count alone is insufficient.
rules.extra: Additional closely related nodes and edges for evaluating useful exploration. Full coverage is optional.
